posts.content_md: while shopping at local art/craft store (Michaels),for frames to mount the Holography Forum holograms , i couldn't believe how inexpensive some of the preframmed/prematted frames were, anyway the 16"x 20" one ,it has many small holes in the matt the for pictures , i purchased 3 @$4 each, the glass is thin ,@ .075 " my local glass guy charges more and his glass is thicker .100"....

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
Just remember that for larger (probably 5x7" and up) you'll probably want to go with thicker glass as it's more stable.

By all means though, test the thicknesses in your environment and go with what you can get away with.

posts.author: dave battin
posts.content_md: the glass will stand up to the emulsion shrinkage down to .050" for smaller size holograms, (thats the same thickness as microscope slide).
